ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by low-intensity black central and lower-peduncle regions transitioning to high-intensity white-grey peripheral lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A central dark pigmentation wedge extends from the base towards the median notch. The left and right lobes feature high-intensity white fields heavily populated with irregular dark-grey mottling and focal pixel clusters, particularly along the outer margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits more pronounced, jagged peaks and deep valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a primarily convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips, interrupted by significant irregular serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial distribution of small, circular, high-intensity white pixel clusters (pockmarks) concentrated on the dark central and lower fluke base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the white-pigmented area of the left lobe, consistent with rake-like marking patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge on the right lobe suggesting prior physical trauma or significant wear; extensive white scarring clustered on the dark central peduncle region.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark focal spot located approximately 15% inward from the upper-left distal tip.
